We recently enjoyed a lovely farm visit where the children had the opportunity to meet and gently interact with a few animals. They explored the surroundings, observed with curiosity and delighted in these hands-on experiences.

Time spent outdoors offers children meaningful opportunities to connect with nature, engage their senses and learn through real-world experiences. It was a day filled with discovery, wonder and many happy little moments.

Location: Vasundharaa’s Farm, Bannerghatta
